sys_script_client.description:
Add field messages to the OHSM investigation case table for Harassment and violence cases. Works in conjunction with the ui policy: H&V add field messages
A client script was used to fix the behaviour of UI policies has a behaviour where the field message will disappear on a change to the field. This was confirmed in the following knowledge article to be the intended behaviour in ServiceNow: https://support.servicenow.com/kb?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0683314.
sys_script_client.name: HOC - H&V - field(s) info message(s)
